engineHooks: native-kernel/crates/billow-kernel/src/engine.rs: RuntimeSnapshot/SharedRuntime (per-generation swap), ConnectionRegistry (live rows + close), relay byte counters
native-kernel/crates/billow-kernel-cli/src/main.rs: Controller starts with the kernel; the tracing logger publishes to the /logs bus

listeners.external-controller: implemented: TCP, started automatically when configured; a hostless ':9090' binds [::]:9090 (IPv4 wildcard fallback); a busy port logs an error and skips that listener without failing the kernel
listeners.external-controller-unix: implemented: Unix socket, unlinked before bind, 0666, no Bearer secret (pinned empty-secret semantics)
listeners.external-controller-tls: implemented: TLS from top-level tls.certificate/tls.private-key; HTTP/1.1 only, ALPN advertises http/1.1 only (pinned also serves h2 through Go's http server)
listeners.external-controller-pipe: unimplemented: rejected by name (Windows named pipe)

auth.tcp_tls: Authorization: Bearer <secret>; exact case/one-space match like pinned
auth.routingOrder: route/method resolution precedes auth, so an unknown path is a plain-text 404 without credentials and a wrong method is 405 with Allow

cors.behavior: Vary: Origin on every response; preflight OPTIONS is 200 without auth; Access-Control-Max-Age 300; Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network mirrors the request

/version.note: meta boolean matches the pinned shape; version is the Rust crate version

/configs.note: PUT builds and validates a replacement generation before swapping; failures keep the old generation

/providers/proxies/:name/healthcheck.note: a Compatible group probes its members asynchronously; default is a 204 no-op

/providers/proxies/:provider/:name.note: Compatible providers (groups and default) resolve members through the group member list / all adapters

/providers/proxies/:provider/:name/healt.note: Compatible providers fall back to the group member or DIRECT instead of 404

missing: a host that does not wire KernelOptions::log_bus only sees controller events; the CLI forwards all tracing
/logs.note: level is validated (pinned error/warning/info/debug/silent) before the 200 stream; a bogus level is 400 Body invalid

/memory.note: inuse is peak RSS via getrusage; oslimit 0

kernelLinkage.selection: PUT /proxies/:group persists through the same SelectionCache as the library/CLI (`profile.store-selected`)
kernelLinkage.delay: GET /proxies/:name/delay and provider node healthcheck dial through the configured proxy chain, DIRECT/hosts resolver and DNS runtime, or the group's selected member
kernelLinkage.connections: live routed TCP tunnels are registered with metadata/chains/rule and byte counters; DELETE notifies the session future and the registry row disappears when the task ends
kernelLinkage.providerUpdate: PUT /providers/{proxies,rules}/:name reuses the T24 update path; the blocking file/http read runs on spawn_blocking so the control loop keeps serving; a failed fetch/compile returns 503 and the old Arc snapshot stays
kernelLinkage.reload: PUT /configs builds providers/geodata/DNS/hosts/groups/rules into a new RuntimeSnapshot on spawn_blocking (blocking provider sockets) and swaps it; new sessions use it, in-flight sessions keep the old generation until they finish (R4)

knownDivergences: PUT /configs cannot move mixed-port/bind-address/dns.listen or change the controller listener/secret; pinned recreates them. The Rust kernel answers 400 naming the field (restart required).
PATCH /configs {"tun":{"enable":true}} is 204 in pinned (it attempts a device); the Rust kernel rejects it with 400 because there is no device layer before T6/T7.

external-controller-tls advertises http/1.1 only: pinned advertises ["h2","http/1.1"] and Go's http server also speaks h2; this router has no HTTP/2 frame layer, so h2-capable clients (curl's default offer) negotiate http/1.1 instead of reading a stream with no SETTINGS.

GET /configs omits pinned General fields with no Rust equivalent (unified-delay, routing-mark, geox-url, sniffing, find-process-mode, tcp-concurrent, keep-alive*) instead of returning fabricated defaults.
/proxies omits the pinned GLOBAL/PASS/COMPATIBLE builtin adapters, which this routing engine does not have.
Rule hit/miss statistics are not tracked, so /rules has no `extra` object.
WebSocket server text frames are implemented; client frames (ping/close) are not parsed (the streams are server-to-client only).

rustTests.result: all default suites pass: lib+controller/config/groups/dns/resources/sessions/protocols/peers (ignored by default) and CLI 11/11; tests/controller.rs 15/15 (8 original + 7 T25-A2 regressions)

platform.note: Unix socket and TLS evidence is macOS arm64 only; Android/iOS controller ownership is host work (T6/T7).

uncovered: HTTP/2 on the control listener: the TLS listener advertises and serves HTTP/1.1 only (pinned serves h2 via Go's http server).
TLS client-certificate authentication (tls.client-auth-type/client-auth-cert) is rejected at load; only server certificates are implemented.
external-controller-pipe (Windows), external-controller-routing-mark and external-ui* are rejected by name.
UDP SOCKS5 associations are not listed individually in /connections; they are closed with the kernel and are not addressable by DELETE.
Pinned rule hit counters (`extra`) and per-URL delay histories are not tracked; /proxies history is only filled from group health results.
GET /configs does not mirror every pinned General key; only fields the kernel honours are reported.
WebSocket client frames and WebSocket /connections interval streams are implemented for server-to-client output but not exercised by the differential (plain streaming is).
